candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of cannabis and cannabinoid substances, including related terminology and associated terms.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to terms related to biochemistry, molecular biology, and organic chemistry.
This vector activates tokens related to the cannabis plant and marijuana.
This feature vector represents qualifying adjectives that categorize domains, types, or contexts of activities, entities, and systems.
This feature vector activates on text tokens containing the letter sequence "cl" or words related to closure, inclusion, and clarity.
This vector represents common Italian auxiliary, modal, and copular verbs in various conjugated forms.
This feature vector represents adjectives or modifiers describing scale, frequency, importance, or difficulty.
This vector represents Italian fused prepositions combining prepositions with definite articles.
This vector activates common Italian noun suffixes and morphological endings denoting abstract concepts, actions, and pluralities.
This vector represents cannabis and related cannabinoids, alongside some noisy string fragments.
